rows.jyutping: jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 ge3 je5
rows.note: This is the all-purpose conversational way to describe an action that is a must.

example.english: Submitting the report is an imperative for us today; we cannot put it off any longer.
example.traditional: 交份報告係我哋今日一定要做嘅嘢，唔可以再拖。
example.jyutping: gaau1 fan2 bou3 gou3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 ge3 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1

rows.note: Use this shorter form when labeling or emphasizing an action that must be done.

example.english: Submitting the form today is an imperative, so nobody should forget.
example.traditional: 今日交表係必做嘅事，大家唔好漏咗。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 gaau1 biu2 hai6 bit1 zou6 ge3 si6 daai6 gaa1 m4 hou2 lau6 zo2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is essential or crucially important.

example.english: Submitting your homework on time is imperative for you.
example.traditional: 準時交功課對你嚟講好重要。
example.jyutping: zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3 deoi3 nei5 lai4 gong2 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this when imperative expresses an urgent obligation rather than importance in the abstract.

example.english: It is imperative that you call the police immediately.
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 bou3 ging2

rows.note: Use this for language, orders, or a tone that gives commands in an authoritative way.

example.english: This document is written in the imperative, and the tone is very forceful.
example.traditional: 呢份文件用命令式寫成，語氣好強硬。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 man4 gin6 jung6 ming6 ling6 sik1 se2 sing4 jyu5 hei3 hou2 koeng4 ngaang6
